title: NBN Reservoir (3RES) POI (VIC) – scheduled maintenance
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance is planned on the NBN Reservoir (3RES) POI in VIC from 12:00am to 3:00am AEDT on Friday 9 October 2026. Services delivered via this POI may experience interruptions of up to 3 hours during the window.

cause.reason: Planned maintenance at the NBN Reservoir (3RES) POI (NNI rehoming)

updates.content: We have scheduled maintenance on the NBN Reservoir (3RES) POI in VIC from 12:00am to 3:00am AEDT on Friday 9 October 2026. During this window, services connected via this POI may experience one or more interruptions, up to 3 hours in total, while we rehome the NBN interconnect (NNI). We will work to minimise downtime and will provide further updates if anything changes.
